description: This Java class 'LayoutEvents' handles various web request actions related to content layout management in the OFBiz framework, including creating, updating, cloning, and replacing layout content and images, as well as copying content to clipboard.

classes.name: LayoutEvents
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for content layout management actions in web requests.

methods.name: createLayoutImage
methods.description: Handles uploading and persisting a new layout image, including content association and image data storage.

methods.name: updateLayoutImage
methods.description: Updates an existing layout image with new image data and metadata.

methods.name: replaceSubContent
methods.description: Replaces sub-content within a layout by creating or updating content associations.

methods.name: cloneLayout
methods.description: Clones a layout content and its associated data resources, creating new content and data resource entries.

methods.name: createLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Creates new sub-content within a layout and manages content associations.

methods.name: updateLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Updates existing sub-content and its associations.

methods.name: copyToClip
methods.description: Copies specified entity data to a clipboard or MRU (Most Recently Used) list.
